title: transcription-sqs-spot-s3
one_liner: Scalable AWS-based audio transcription system using SQS queues, EC2 Spot instances, and WhisperX/Voxtral models.
what_it_is: A production-ready infrastructure-as-code solution for transcribing audio files stored in S3. It uses an SQS queue to manage job distribution to EC2 Spot instances (GPU or CPU) running containerized or native workers. The system supports automatic scaling, cost optimization via Spot instances, and dead-letter queue handling for failed jobs.
how_its_built: The system is orchestrated via Bash scripts that configure AWS resources (IAM, SQS, ECR) and deploy workers. Workers are Python applications using FastAPI, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers (Whisper or Voxtral). Deployment supports two paths: traditional EC2 user-data installation or Docker containers pushed to Amazon ECR.
how_to_apply: Use this project to build a cost-effective, scalable transcription backend for applications requiring high-volume audio processing. It is suitable for podcast transcription, meeting notes, or media archival where latency is secondary to cost and reliability.
features: Automated provisioning of SQS queues and IAM roles via shell scripts
Support for EC2 Spot instances with GPU (NVIDIA T4) acceleration
Dual deployment modes: Traditional EC2 setup and Docker/ECR containerization
Integration with WhisperX and Voxtral models for high-accuracy transcription
Automatic idle shutdown and dead-letter queue handling for cost control
Health monitoring endpoints and comprehensive benchmarking scripts
